Page 1018 
Kygevvi (doxecitine/doxribtimine) 
 
  
  
Prior Authorization Guideline 
 
  
Guideline ID 
GL-628290  
Guideline Name 
Kygevvi (doxecitine/doxribtimine)  
Formulary 
• 
Medicaid - Community & State Arizona  
 
 
Guideline Note: 
Effective Date: 
7/1/2026  
 
 
 
 
1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:Kygevvi  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Initial Authorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) confirming a diagnosis of thymidine 
kinase 2 deficiency (TK2d)  


--- PDF page 1019 ---
UnitedHealthcare Community Plan of Arizona – Clinical Pharmacy Guidelines 
Page 1019 
 
AND 
 
2 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) confirming the presence of a mutation in 
the TK2 gene as detected by an FDA (Food and Drug Administration)-approved test or a test 
performed at a facility approved by Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA)  
 
AND 
 
3 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) confirming the patient experienced 
symptom onset on or before 12 years of age  
 
AND 
 
4 - Prescribed by or in consultation with a clinical specialist knowledgeable in the treatment of 
TK2d (e.g., geneticist, neurologist)  
 
Product Name:Kygevvi  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Reauthorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Provider attests the patient would benefit from continued therapy  
 
AND 
 
2 - Prescribed by or in consultation with a clinical specialist knowledgeable in the treatment of 
TK2d (e.g., geneticist, neurologist)  
 
2 .  Revision History
